updates.title: Trust controls, Founder Signal, and open architecture
updates.summary: A public signal system, reusable AI architecture assets, and a concentrated pass on security, discoverability, and release integrity.
updates.audience: Founders, AI architects, creators, and partners
highlights: Launched Founder Signal as a public operating surface, then added rate limits, validation, and abuse controls around its intake path.
Published free MIT-licensed AI architecture templates and a reproducible first-party benchmark method for evaluating model and system choices.
Hardened Auth.js and protobuf dependencies, escaped applicant inputs, and expanded the merge gate, canonical metadata, and link integrity checks.
Connected GenCreator to the primary site chrome and published a source-led guide to model ownership and platform risk.

updates.title: A more resilient public agentic workspace
updates.summary: The site became a clearer public workspace while checkout, mobile rendering, journal structure, and content integrity gained stronger failure modes.
highlights: Reframed FrankX as a public agentic workspace and introduced a shared production release foundation for safer, repeatable launches.
Added the Expert Authority Intelligence System with durable signal persistence for evidence-led profile work.
Made checkout fail closed, repaired soft-404 behavior, and separated the journal from the long-form blog archive.
Improved mobile paint and contrast for the Alba experience while restoring the premium homepage and embedded music playback.

updates.title: Learning paths, conversion, and production truth
updates.summary: New learning and event journeys arrived alongside stricter public-claim, consent, pricing, and production-state controls.
updates.audience: Learners, event participants, creators, and prospective clients
highlights: Opened a curated AI learning hub and expanded the Tallinn field journey across event, contact, and creator pathways.
Added a ChatGPT Sites founder guide and a source-led authority lab for subject-matter experts.
Connected email capture to the major hub journeys and replaced ambiguous studio CTAs with honest intake and conversion paths.
Introduced CI refusals for generic AI copy while tightening learning claims, consent, affiliate disclosure, pricing, and public production-state language.

updates.title: Scores, skills, and founder research
updates.summary: FrankX added concrete assessment tools, a richer research spine, and lower-cost release controls for the agentic builder ecosystem.
updates.audience: Founders, enterprise AI teams, and agent builders
highlights: Published Intent Architecture and the Agentic Life Observatory as connected research surfaces for founders building with AI.
Added an AI Center of Excellence readiness assessment and Agent Stack Scorecard for more concrete decision support.
Released public Q&A pages designed for answer-engine discovery and re-established the AI Architect and Creator positioning.
Documented Codex team skills and plugin governance while reducing static prerender and draft-preview build cost.

updates.title: Proof-led FrankX and connected learning portals
updates.summary: The public experience shifted toward owned proof, connected learning, a large music catalog, and stronger production operations.
updates.audience: Creators, learners, music makers, and AI practitioners
highlights: Rebuilt the homepage around proof-led positioning and clearer outcome language for the core audience.
Connected AI learning portals, music learning, and the music-first studio into a navigable creator journey.
Indexed an 817-track music catalog and expanded the Fable and Book of Secrets reading experiences.
Added production QA across errors, sitemap, blog, links, admin access, analytics privacy, and newsletter operations.

updates.title: Research, books, and runtime resilience
updates.summary: A broad research and publishing expansion shipped with safer write paths, stronger structured data, and a sustained Next.js performance program.
updates.audience: Readers, researchers, creators, and platform operators
highlights: Released new book and research experiences including Coherence, Wordless Laws, Higher Self, Reality Architect, and Model Arena.
Moved write surfaces behind stronger authorization and added MDX, JSON-LD, sitemap, and internal-link safeguards.
Refreshed frontier-model coverage with source-led updates and repaired structured-data rendering failures.
Split large routes into server shells and bounded clients to reduce hydration and improve production runtime behavior.

updates.title: Builder Lab, Ikigai, and production foundations
updates.summary: May established the workshop, learning, partnership, and builder surfaces while repairing navigation, deployment cost, accessibility, and SEO foundations.
updates.audience: Workshop participants, builders, partners, and first-time visitors
highlights: Launched the Agentic Builder Lab, commercial build hub, Gemini and Google AI learning portal, and a premium in-person connect route.
Iterated the Ikigai workshop into one canonical audience-first experience with guided prompts and presenter support.
Expanded the partnership architecture and repaired core navigation, mobile menu, landmarks, and broken routes.
Reduced Vercel trace and prerender cost while fixing sitemap bundling, RSS, canonical, type, and production build failures.
